Name: Siasz's Haley Portraits
Author: Siasz
Description: I hope you all like my drawing of her, I started testing how to do slightly more realistic hair than I do from my other drawings, it was very tricky but I'm mostly pleased with the results. I would have liked to make her hair curlier but I am not very good with curly hair yet. I only use Portraiture right now because I do not know how to use any of the other portrait mods currently. If you would like to see it done another way, just send me a message and explain how to do so and I will. Also: I am sorry for delays on all of my portraits, I know I need to get beach portraits for all my finished pieces, life has just been hard lately. Hope you all enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into the zipped folder, copy and paste the image into the portraiture mod where your other images are, if it asks to replace any existing images, click yes.
